description: The phone numbers on the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx account: number, id, SMS / MMS / voice capability, whether its texts come into the Hermoso Inbox, where its calls go (forwarded to a phone or a voice agent, recorded, missed-call text-back, the ad campaign it tracks). Read live from the provider. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: list_phone_numbers
title: List phone numbers
